classes.title: Assertion softened into a tautology

fixtures.violation:
from decimal import Decimal

from billing import invoice_total


def test_invoice_total_applies_discount() -> None:
    total = invoice_total(subtotal=Decimal("100.00"), discount_pct=10)
    assert total == total
    assert True


def test_invoice_total_rejects_negative_discount() -> None:
    total = invoice_total(subtotal=Decimal("50.00"), discount_pct=0)
    assert total == total
fixtures.nearMiss:
from decimal import Decimal

from billing import invoice_total


def test_invoice_total_applies_discount() -> None:
    expected_total = Decimal("90.00")
    total = invoice_total(subtotal=Decimal("100.00"), discount_pct=10)
    assert total == expected_total


def test_invoice_total_is_idempotent() -> None:
    first = invoice_total(subtotal=Decimal("50.00"), discount_pct=0)
    second = invoice_total(subtotal=Decimal("50.00"), discount_pct=0)
    assert first == second

classes.gapNotes: Only catches self-comparison of a simple name and literal assert True. Weaker predicates such as assert result is not None, widened tolerances and relaxed expected constants are not covered.

classes.title: Test skipped or xfailed instead of fixed
classes.gapNotes: Legitimate platform gates and optional-feature skips use the same tokens as abandoned tests, so this check also refuses those introductions. unittest.skip, unittest.expectedFailure and runner filters are not covered; the check cannot determine whether a quarantine is justified.

classes.title: Test body emptied to pass
classes.gapNotes: Only literal pass and ellipsis bodies are covered. Assertions replaced by setup, printing or a tautology, deleted tests, unittest runTest methods, and a docstring before pass are outside these patterns.

classes.title: Early return short-circuits a test

fixtures.violation:
from auth import verify_token


def test_verify_token_rejects_expired() -> None:
    return
    assert verify_token("expired") is False


def test_verify_token_accepts_fresh() -> None:
    return None
    assert verify_token("fresh") is True

classes.gapNotes: Only a return as the first statement is covered. A return after setup, a conditional early return and unreachable assertions are not analyzed.

classes.title: Exception test that accepts any failure
classes.gapNotes: Only literal Exception and BaseException in the listed pytest.raises forms are covered. Broad exception aliases and multiline forms outside those shapes are missed; this check does not evaluate whether an exception type is appropriate.

classes.title: Blanket type: ignore silences the checker

fixtures.violation:
# mypy: ignore-errors
from external_sdk import Client


def fetch_user(client: Client, user_id: str) -> dict:
    raw = client.users.get(user_id)  # type: ignore
    return raw.to_dict()  # type: ignore
fixtures.nearMiss:
from external_sdk import Client


def fetch_user(client: Client, user_id: str) -> dict:
    raw = client.users.get(user_id)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return raw.to_dict()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]

classes.gapNotes: Comments remain visible, so prose discussing a bare ignore can also match. Coded ignores such as type: ignore[misc] and suppression through configuration are outside these patterns.

classes.title: Blanket noqa disables the linter on a line

fixtures.violation:
import os  # noqa
import sys  # noqa
from legacy.util import *  # noqa


def env_or(name: str, default: str) -> str:
    return os.environ.get(name, default)  # noqa

classes.gapNotes: Comments remain visible, so prose mentioning noqa can also match. Specific suppression codes, per-file configuration and top-level ignore lists are not judged.

classes.gapNotes: Only the listed literal settings and thresholds are covered. A reduction that remains above the pattern threshold, deleted flags or tables, and command-line or workflow overrides are missed. Quoted text remains visible because TOML addopts carries settings in a string. INI and CFG full-line # and ; comments are blanked; inline markers remain value text. Custom parser comment rules are not inferred.
